chunks: Or, you come to possess a house of gold; or ascend to the skies, though we shall not believe in your having ascended till you bring down a book for us which we could read." Say: "Glory to my Lord. I am only man and a messenger."
ai.seo_question: What was the specific challenge the disbelievers posed to Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) to verify his message?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the disbelievers' demand for tangible, material proofs of prophethood, contrasting with the spiritual reality of the Mi'raj. The Prophet's response, 'I am only a human messenger,' underscores the core Shia principle that prophets are chosen humans who convey divine will, not autonomous miracle-workers, thereby validating the authenticity of the Quran as the primary, enduring miracle.
